decisions.question: SDD pre-flight for nidana.model.10 (spot-check): which model implements each task?

options.label: Sonnet for every task
options.consequence: The run's rule for non-full-review phases; the plan's code was dry-run.

options.label: Opus for Task 3 (canonical orders)
options.consequence: More capable on the cross-library ordering; departs from the run's rule.

decisions.why: The run's model rule and nidana.model.8 and .9's precedent; every Dart block was dry-run (docs/auto-run/experiments/ir-values-plan/).
evidence: docs/auto-run/impl-execution-plan.md How a phase runs item 3

decisions.question: nidana.model.10 Task 4's review found that a state-sink check by name only would pass every test (two state sinks of one name and variant but different typeName are two TopicRefs). Carry a test into Task 5 though it edits Task 4's file?

options.label: Carry it into Task 5 by ruling (one test, its own commit)
options.consequence: The mutant is killed before the final review; one sanctioned deviation in the doc.

options.label: Leave it to the final review
options.consequence: A code-adjacent change in the final wave and a gate re-run.

decisions.chosen: Carry it into Task 5 by ruling (one test, its own commit)
decisions.why: Same pattern as nidana.model.9 Task 4; the final wave stayed doc-only.

decisions.question: nidana.model.10's final review said Ready to merge: Yes, with three wording points in the verification doc (an inaccurate 'Not in the gate', a routing record labelled a deviation, an awkward sentence). Fix before merge?

options.label: One doc-only fix wave; the controller re-reviews the 3-line diff itself
options.consequence: The owner signs accurate evidence; one cheap dispatch.

options.label: Merge as is
options.consequence: The owner signs 'Not in the gate' for guarantees whose package tests the gate runs.

decisions.chosen: One doc-only fix wave; the controller re-reviews the 3-line diff itself
decisions.why: The doc is owner-signed evidence; the wave changes nothing under packages/, so no gate re-run.
